page.overview:
Who is Ahtu?

Ahtu is a fictional entity in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by David Drake for his short story "Than Curse the Darkness".

Ahtu is one of Nyarlathotep's countless avatars, worshipped mainly in central and southern Africa. It manifests in the form of a black column of viscous matter, around fifty feet in diameter, erupting from below the ground. Several golden tentacles sprout from its central mass.

Dame Alice Kilrea likens this entity to a "cancer" that permeates and mutates its environment into an imitation of life which, if allowed to grow unchecked, would eventually cover the entire Earth and transform the planet into "a ball of viscid slime hurtling around the sun", and then stretch its tentacles towards Mars. (: "Than Curse the Darkness")

It is believed that Ahtu can be called only at certain special locations in Africa, such as in the Congo Free State, although others may exist. To contact Ahtu with a spell, a special golden amulet depicting a three-lobed eye wreathed by flames is necessary. (: Arkham Unveiled)
